name: Pub Bar & Grill
description: The Pub Bar & Grill offers a lively karaoke experience with a friendly neighborhood atmosphere. Guests enjoy a well-maintained space with a good sound system, a decent song selection, and the option for private rooms. The venue features a welcoming crowd, attentive staff, and serves food and drinks, making it a great spot for casual karaoke nights, celebrations, or just unwinding with friends. Open regularly, it’s a popular local spot for karaoke enthusiasts.
